request: Explain retrieval-augmented generation, ground the explanation in the AI Engineering material, and draw the runtime flow.

candidate_components.label: Learner's chat client
candidate_components.responsibility: Lets a user ask a natural-language question and displays the grounded answer with its supporting sources.

candidate_components.label: RAG conversation service
candidate_components.responsibility: Owns the RAG request lifecycle: accepts the question, retrieves relevant knowledge, augments the prompt, calls the model, and returns the answer.

candidate_components.label: Query retrieval
candidate_components.responsibility: Embeds the incoming question and searches the vector index for the most relevant knowledge chunks to supplement the prompt.

candidate_components.label: Prompt assembly
candidate_components.responsibility: Builds the retrieval-augmented prompt by combining the user's question, instructions, and retrieved chunks before sending it to the model.

candidate_components.label: Vector index of knowledge chunks
candidate_components.responsibility: Stores embeddings of knowledge-base chunks so retrieval can find passages semantically related to the question.

candidate_components.label: Knowledge chunk store
candidate_components.responsibility: Stores the source documents and chunk text that retrieved passages are drawn from and cited back to.

candidate_components.label: External foundation model API
candidate_components.responsibility: Generates the answer text from the augmented prompt using a general-purpose hosted language model.

candidate_context.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Runtime Flow
assumptions: The diagram teaches the RAG pattern from the AI Engineering material rather than designing a specific product.
The foundation model is accessed as an external inference API; the system does not train or update it.
Knowledge content is prepared and indexed ahead of time; the runtime flow only reads it.
Responses are generated for the requesting user only and do not write to any external system.
